title: A menu in the dock says its whole value when you rest on it
goal: When a menu in the right hand panel is too narrow for what it is showing, resting the pointer on it should say the whole thing. That works today, but nothing can check it, so it can break silently. Give the loop a way to read what a control in the panel would say.
notes:
Found while pinning the Font menu width (2026-09-07). SwiftUI .help() is invisible from AppKit: it sets neither NSView.toolTip nor accessibilityHelp on the backing views, and a synthesized mouse move does not raise a help tag, so neither a picture nor a panel readout can prove the tip. Two ways out: (a) a probe-only registry the way InspectorLayoutProbe records section frames, written from the same expression that feeds .help(); (b) move the dock onto the app's own designed tooltip (HintAnchorView, Sources/Photonz/HintTooltip.swift), which a walk can already hover by label and photograph, but that is 30 call sites in LayersPanel.swift and a visible change in Next.

DONE 2026-09-08 by route (a). New: Sources/Photonz/Playtest/PanelHelpProbe.swift (HelpAnchorView, View.panelHelp, PlaytestPanelHelp.tip(at:in:)). PlaytestPanelThing gained .tooltip and PlaytestAction gained setTextFontLongName/setTextFontShortName (TextStyles.longNameForPlaytest = "Bodoni 72 Smallcaps", shortNameForPlaytest = fonts[0]); the Font menu can only reach a shortened state through those, because it offers a family only once a label wears it. PlaytestHarness.readPanel appends `says "..."` to every menu line and panelReading gained the .tooltip case. Walk: Scripts/playtest/menu-says-its-whole-value-walk.json. Audit: queue/audits/2026-09-08-panel-tooltip-readout.json. Watch out: GeometryInspector has a static RegionGeometry.help(_:) that a blind sed rename catches — it is not the View modifier.
acceptance: A scripted walk can read, in words, what any menu in the panel says when the pointer rests on it
The Font menu carrying a shortened family name is covered by that check
Nothing about what a person sees changes

log.note: Adversarial review before building. (a) A registry fed by a SEPARATE string proves nothing: it would pass while .help() was deleted. So one modifier writes both, and a walk reading "none" means the tooltip is really gone. (b) Option (b) from the notes, moving the dock onto HintTooltip, fails acceptance 3: it is a visible change in Next across 30 sites. Rejected. (c) The panel already reads tooltips for segmented pickers via PlaytestPanelPress.tip(at:among:) — reuse that resolver rather than inventing a second one, so a walk asks one question whichever tooltip system draws. (d) Shortest version: the modifier, one call site (SelectionMenu covers Font, Size and Weight), the tooltip in what a panel step already writes, and an expect thing:tooltip so a walk can hold it to words. (e) A walk cannot reach a clipped Font menu through the UI at all — the menu only offers a long family once a layer already wears one — so an action is needed to put one on, the way setTextSizeLarge already exists for exactly that reason.

Built route (a). panelHelp is one expression that feeds .help() and an invisible probe-only marker, so the two can never disagree. Reading goes through PlaytestPanelHelp.tip(at:in:), which merges the marker with the app's own HintAnchorView and lets the smallest one win, the same rule the alignment rows already read their per-picture names by. A panel step's menus list now carries what each menu says; expect thing:tooltip holds one to its words, narrowed by row the way a control is.

Reproduced the thing the task exists to stop. Deleted the panelHelp line from SelectionMenu, rebuilt the probe, ran the walk: it failed at step 15 with `no tooltip called "Font" is in the panel to read; the ones that are: 81%, Text, Add Effect, Color, Shadow, ...`, naming every control that still talks. Restored it and the walk is green. Before this change nothing anywhere would have noticed.

Adversarial review of the built thing found the readout only half honest: the Shadow Kind menu carries a .help() and read "says nothing". Converted all 125 .help() sites in the dock files plus the zoom percentage, which is the one menu outside the dock a panel readout lists. Every menu the readout names now says its words. Second finding: control names repeat (two Colors, two Locks on an ordinary selection), so expect thing:tooltip takes `in` after all.

Verified: Scripts/test.sh 4917 tests green; menu-says-its-whole-value-walk green with a real screen capture; seven existing panel walks (wrapped-label-width, corner-radius-rounds, label-fills-a-row, effects-remembered, parts-settings-inline, switch-says-mixed, border-off-keeps-its-row) still green, so the extra probe-only markers do not disturb panel layout. Nothing a person sees changes: the release build compiles PHOTONZ_PLAYTEST out entirely (Scripts/build-app.sh only passes -DPHOTONZ_PLAYTEST for non-release variants), so the shipping binary carries plain .help().

panelHelp(_:) feeds .help() and a probe-only marker from one expression, so a walk can read what any control in the dock would say on hover. A panel step's menus list now ends each line with says "...", and expect gained a tooltip thing (narrowed by in, like a control). Verified by deleting the tooltip and watching the new walk go red naming Font, then restoring it; Scripts/test.sh green at 4917 and seven existing panel walks still green. Nothing a person sees changes: the release build compiles the whole thing out. Shipped in 87fb2a75, audit queue/audits/2026-09-08-panel-tooltip-readout.json with a real window capture.
